headline.en: Check the next call against the task budget.
headline.zh: 用任务预算检查下一次调用。

sub.en: AgentFuse SDK places a per-task budget around wrapped LiteLLM calls, reserving estimated cost before delegation and settling it after usage is reported.
sub.zh: AgentFuse SDK 为经过包装的 LiteLLM 调用提供任务预算，在委托前预留估计成本，返回用量后结算。

body.en: An over-budget reservation fails before delegation.
body.zh: 超预算预留在委托前失败。

body.en: Concurrent estimates share the pending balance.
body.zh: 并发估计共用待结算余额。

body.en: Reservations are released or committed explicitly.

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The budget-only example runs from source with Python 3.11+ and explicit synthetic reservations; full LiteLLM adapter use requires the dependencies in pyproject.toml.
note.zh: 纯预算示例可用 Python 3.11+ 从源码运行，使用明确合成预留；完整 LiteLLM 适配需要 pyproject.toml 中的依赖。

body.en: The budget-only example runs from source with Python 3.11+ and explicit synthetic reservations; full LiteLLM adapter use requires the dependencies in pyproject.toml.
body.zh: 纯预算示例可用 Python 3.11+ 从源码运行，使用明确合成预留；完整 LiteLLM 适配需要 pyproject.toml 中的依赖。

limitations.en: Only calls using the wrapper and active budget are governed. Direct SDK calls, external processes and unrelated services remain outside that budget.
limitations.zh: 只有经过包装器且处于活跃预算内的调用受管理；直接 SDK、外部进程和无关服务不在预算范围。

limitations.en: Admission depends on token and price estimates. Incorrect provider pricing or unexpectedly larger usage can make the final bill differ from the estimate.
limitations.zh: 准入依赖 token 与价格估计；提供方价格不准确或实际用量超预期时，最终账单可能偏离估计。

limitations.en: The demo exercises reservations with synthetic amounts. It does not call LiteLLM or measure real provider spend.
limitations.zh: 示例使用合成金额验证预留机制，不调用 LiteLLM，也不测量提供方实际消费。

body.en: Concurrent calls can each appear affordable while together exceeding the remaining budget. Pending reservations make in-flight estimates visible to the next admission decision.
body.zh: 并发调用各自可能看似可负担，合计却超过剩余预算。待结算预留让下一次准入决策看到在途估计。

body.en: Fuse scopes the active task budget. The wrapper estimates a call, reserves its cost, then invokes LiteLLM only if admitted. Success settles the reservation against reported usage; failures release it. The budget can constrain cumulative spend, token count and per-call cost.
body.zh: Fuse 确定活跃任务预算。包装器估计调用并预留成本，准入后才调用 LiteLLM。成功时按报告用量结算，失败时释放预留。预算可约束累计费用、token 与单次费用。

body.en: Fuse scopes the active task budget. The wrapper estimates a call, reserves its cost, then invokes LiteLLM only if admitted. Success settles the reservation against reported usage; failures release it. The budget can constrain cumulative spend, token count and per-call cost.
body.zh: Fuse 确定活跃任务预算。包装器估计调用并预留成本，准入后才调用 LiteLLM。成功时按报告用量结算，失败时释放预留。预算可约束累计费用、token 与单次费用。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: Use agentfuse.install() to wrap LiteLLM’s completion functions, then run calls inside Fuse(max_spend_usd=...). Direct agentfuse.completion is another entrypoint. Set completion limits and choose on_unpriced deliberately; block is the default, while warn-pass bypasses meaningful price enforcement for unknown models.
body.zh: 使用 agentfuse.install() 包装 LiteLLM completion 函数，再在 Fuse(max_spend_usd=...) 中运行；也可直接调用 agentfuse.completion。应设置生成上限并明确选择 on_unpriced；默认 block，而 warn-pass 会让未知模型绕过有效费用约束。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
# Full adapter installation:
python -m pip install -e .
# Offline core example:
PYTHONPATH=src python3 examples/presentation-demo.py
